items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 6.8% in 1985 to 9.0% in 2025 across 622 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

15 of 622 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 56 for salt or chloride; 20 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 622 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 22 of 22 high-need ones have none.
